steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies and help you understand any prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Classes run on a schedule designed for working professionals in Tampa's healthcare, finance, technology, and logistics sectors. You'll study project management frameworks, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management in real time with active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online submission process to ensure accuracy and completeness.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and live review sessions—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. On test day, you'll answer 180 multiple-choice questions in a proctored environment, either online or at a local testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a 3-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by completing training, conferences, volunteer work, or mentoring. Renew your credential on schedule to keep it active and demonstrate your ongoing commitment to project-management excellence in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
